definitions.ask: How should `sase-listen doctor` treat a renderer/feed-host build mismatch?

choices.label: `feed:host-build` FAILs (doctor exits 3) on any known build mismatch
`feed:host-build` stays ok but its detail names both builds and the fix

definitions.why: Drift is the failure class we hit; doctor is diagnostic-only and nothing gates on it.

definitions.ask: Should a successful remote publish add a warning when the feed host's build differs?
definitions.why: Users rarely run doctor; the publish/render output is where drift must surface.

definitions.why: All three run different stale commits today; the mac is 10 commits behind.
